purpose: Dallas NFL Gamecast accessibility, replay, responsive-layout and production observability contract.

responsiveComposition.coordinateSpace: Resolve player and football anchors in field-local normalized coordinates before viewport projection.
responsiveComposition.resize: Viewport resize or orientation change reprojects canonical anchors without restarting the play animation.
responsiveComposition.safeArea: Keep authored player silhouettes and possession-critical football pixels clear of Gamecast controls and mobile safe-area insets.
responsiveComposition.scaleGuard: Responsive scaling is scene-wide; never independently stretch a player's approved body proportions or identity details.
responsiveComposition.footAnchor: Every responsive projection preserves bottom-center planted-foot contact with the field plane.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Honor reduced-motion by selecting representative authored key poses and existing textual Gamecast event output instead of rapid motion.
accessibility.meaning: Chibi animation is additive presentation; score, down, distance, clock, possession and play result remain available in existing semantic UI.
accessibility.focus: Decorative chibi layers never enter keyboard focus order or intercept Gamecast controls.
accessibility.flashGuard: Do not add rapid flashing, strobing or celebration effects that are required to understand an event.

replay.source: Replay is reconstructed from the authoritative play snapshot and roster/action inventory, not mutable live animation state.
replay.determinism: The same normalized play fingerprint, participant roles and asset inventory resolve the same action sequence and football ownership.
replay.signatureEligibility: Verified signature eligibility is recomputed from the replayed event; replay controls may intentionally replay an eligible signature while polling may not.
replay.corrections: If an authoritative correction changes the play fingerprint or participant role, invalidate the prior replay recipe before rendering.

observability.scope: NFL chibi telemetry is namespaced to nfl.chibi.DAL and cannot alter MLB/NHL runtime state.
observability.privacy: Record asset/action identifiers and play fingerprints only; do not add user-identifying telemetry.
observability.failurePolicy: Telemetry failure is non-blocking and never suppresses existing Gamecast presentation.

identityGuards.appearanceAuthority: current official Dallas headshot lock; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name

checks: Responsive projection preserves canonical scale and foot anchors without animation restart.
Reduced-motion and semantic Gamecast presentation remain usable without animation.
Replay reconstruction is deterministic and correction-aware.
Polling cannot masquerade as intentional replay for verified signatures.
Observability is non-blocking, privacy-minimal and NFL/Dallas scoped.
No MLB/NHL runtime or metadata dependency is introduced.
